description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of Reference Answer and Test Case” depicts the composition of items by whether they are null, have a reference answer, or have a test case, and it contains three slices. The “Null (549,238)” slice is shown in pink and visually occupies roughly two-fifths of the circle (about 39%). The “Have reference answer (543,935)” slice is shown in blue and is labeled “Have reference answer (38.9%),” taking just under two-fifths of the pie. The “Have test case (306,818)” slice is shown in light green and is labeled “Have test case (21.9%),” covering a bit over one-fifth of the pie. A legend appears in the upper-left listing the three categories with their counts, percentage labels are shown on at least the blue and green slices, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the slices appear arranged with the two largest segments adjacent and the smallest segment occupying the upper-right portion.
